meta.title: A sweet land of desserts from around the world
meta.description: Dessert Land is a global shop introducing and selling desserts from around the world, available in 10 languages.

hero.tagline: A sweet land where desserts from every corner of the world gather, introduced and sold in 10 languages.

manifesto.text: From the sweetness of a milkshake to the char of a Basque cheesecake, every bite holds the time of a place. We seek out the world’s desserts and bring them to you in your own language.

zoom.title: A world in every slice
zoom.body: The closer you look, the more stories you see. We share the ingredients, the origins and the craft.

world.title: A journey through world desserts
world.lede: Travel sideways through the sweetness of each country.
